inputs.text: Full-body portrait of a single adult male dwarf cleric standing facing forward against a plain dark neutral background, head-to-toe shot with space above the helmet and feet visible on the ground. He is short, standing well under five feet tall, with an extremely wide, stocky, heavyweight build, massive broad shoulders, a wide neck, and a strikingly small compact head, noticeably small relative to his huge upper body, small helmet fitting a small head. sharp, weathered facial features with gaunt hard cheeks, half-hidden beneath a simple tight-fitting steel helmet with cheek guards, with an enormously thick massive black beard covering his cheeks and chin completely, only his eyes, nose and brow visible above the beard mass, huge bushy unkempt black mustache merging into the beard, beard ending high on his chest well above his belt buckle, clearly separate from his fur garments, no beard below the belt. Calm, bemused curiosity shines from his eyes with a relaxed brow. He wears a low-cut heavy fur vest exposing his wide muscular neck, scarred leather bracers on his forearms, a wide leather belt with a large brass buckle shaped as an upright mace in front of a tall boot, and frost-covered boots on his feet. His hands rest empty at his sides. no oversized head, no large head, no bobblehead. Photorealistic, highly detailed.
